string.text: %c[255,238,155,23]Railcar Over the Bridge\n%c[default]Hid ammo in a railcar during the regroup. Don't forget.
%c[255,238,155,23]Anomaly Victim's Gear\n%c[default]Saw some stalker die in an anomaly in the forest near the railway tunnel, his gear looked decent.
%c[255,238,155,23]Cross by the Bandit Camp\n%c[default]Hid my loot under the cross near the bandit camp.
%c[255,238,155,23]Bandit Stockpile\n%c[default]A crate intercepted by bandits was found in the attic of the central house. Need to get a squad ready and take it back.
%c[255,238,155,23]Under the Cross\n%c[default]When me and the boys were fighting off the dogs in uniform, I buried some goods under the cross. Let it lie.
%c[255,238,155,23]Attic Hideout\n%c[default]Shoved the backpack in the attic. I'll come back later, no chance for now.
%c[255,238,155,23]Farm Safe\n%c[default]Found a half-buried safe on the farm, will keep my goods there for now.
%c[255,238,155,23]Railcar Container\n%c[default]The boys whispered that someone is hiding something in a railcar on the bridge, should check on the way back. Wish I knew who.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stalker's Goods\n%c[default]Hid the goods right under the roof, in the little house near the bridge.
%c[255,238,155,23]Gear by the Bridge\n%c[default]Hid my gear in one of the crates not far from the bridge. That's it, I'm done. Leaving the Zone, goodbye, boys! Won't forget my mother.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack by the Village\n%c[default]Some stalker died near the rookie camp, should check out his stuff.
%c[255,238,155,23]Village Attic\n%c[default]Stash in the attic, got it from Likhoy. He ran his mouth too much, so we took him out.
%c[255,238,155,23]Handy Spot\n%c[default]Found a great stash in the attic, will wait until someone puts something in it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Vorpal's Stash\n%c[default]Stash in the attic, got it from Vorpal. Our guys were scouting the area. We'll check it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Commander's Valuables\n%c[default]They say the commander has a tricky crate in his office, and it's packed with valuables.
%c[255,238,155,23]By the Country Road\n%c[default]Some stalker died near the rookie camp, should see what he was carrying. Who even lets them through here?
%c[255,238,155,23]Thieves' Attic\n%c[default]Hid my loot in the bandits' attic while they were away. Now to find a moment to grab it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Gas Pipe\n%c[default]Found gear in a pipe not far from the farm. Once the guardhouse time is over I'll definitely come back.
%c[255,238,155,23]Hidden Gear\n%c[default]Dropped my backpack near the post, need to grab it fast before the commander moves us to another location.
%c[255,238,155,23]Checkpoint Tower\n%c[default]Left a crate on the watchtower for now. Will pick it up when I can.
%c[255,238,155,23]Bandit Stash\n%c[default]Saw a bandit hide his goods in a crate in the hangar. How to snatch it quietly?
%c[255,238,155,23]Old Crane\n%c[default]Me and Vasya went to see what's what, and a cop's bullet got Vasya. I had nothing to do with it. Bullets are stupid. Stashed my stuff on the crane, in a pipe.
%c[255,238,155,23]Grizzly's Gear\n%c[default]In the Garbage, in the railway tunnel behind the diesel, Grizzly died with all his junk. Shame about the guy.
%c[255,238,155,23]Pipe on the North Heap\n%c[default]Stashed the loot in a pipe in the Garbage.
%c[255,238,155,23]Scrap Metal Stash\n%c[default]The stuff is lying in the Garbage, in a pipe. If you don't know exactly where, you'll never find it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Cast-Iron Pipe by the Tanks\n%c[default]Hid my junk in a metal pipe near two tanks. Should pick it up, but no time.
%c[255,238,155,23]Pipe on the East Heap\n%c[default]Among the radioactive trash, where few ever go, some useful things are hidden.
%c[255,238,155,23]Nobody's Backpack\n%c[default]Someone's backpack lies in a hollow, anomalies all around. How to reach it?
%c[255,238,155,23]Dead Man's Gear\n%c[default]We whacked a snitch in the swamp and buried him there. His loot we left under the cross, no time for that.
%c[255,238,155,23]Rotten Stump\n%c[default]Stash in a stump, good spot.
%c[255,238,155,23]Log in the Forest\n%c[default]There's a log in the forest with a hole inside. A treasure's in it, time to pick it up.

%c[255,238,155,23]Strelok Group's Cache\n%c[default]Petrenko passed on info about the Strelok group's stash in the Garbage. There should be a hatch on the plain, in a hollow, he told me the trick to open it. When things calm down, we should go there.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash in the Car\n%c[default]Stashed it in a car, Lanky said it's a good spot.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stalker's Backpack in the Bus\n%c[default]Put my backpack in the bus, looks unnoticeable.
%c[255,238,155,23]Outhouse Supplies\n%c[default]Put my supplies in a crate, in a strange little house around the corner. Still don't get what that building is for.
%c[255,238,155,23]Safe on the South Heap\n%c[default]Half-buried safe on a trash heap, it's all in there. Just don't forget what.
%c[255,238,155,23]Scrap Metal Cache\n%c[default]Put the loot in a pipe on a trash heap.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate Supplies\n%c[default]The boss radioed to pull back. I came across a crate, dumped the extra weight in it and left light.
%c[255,238,155,23]Pipe by the Bus\n%c[default]Shoved the loot in a pipe in the Garbage. It won't lie there long.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack in the Ruins\n%c[default]Hid the backpack well in the ruins. Hope it's easy to get, if bandits don't get in the way.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate at the Roadblock\n%c[default]While Duty were shooting it out, I stashed my loot in a trailer. Need to get in somehow and grab it. And thank Duty.
%c[255,238,155,23]Weakling's Backpack\n%c[default]They say Weakling kicked it in the Garbage, should go check his loot. Before a crowd of others shows up.
%c[255,238,155,23]String Bag in the Hatch\n%c[default]Will hide my goods in the hatch for now, maybe they won't find it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Under the Bucket\n%c[default]Someone died in an anomaly by the excavator, the backpack is visible, but hard to get.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Under the Concrete Blocks\n%c[default]Barely squeezed under the beams, but hid the backpack well, nobody will come here.
%c[255,238,155,23]Grey's Stash\n%c[default]Our stash is in the tunnel for now, all the goods are in the pipe. It's a good spot, few know about it, and the anomalies put people off climbing in.
%c[255,238,155,23]Hollow Stump\n%c[default]Hid it in a stump near the tunnel. Handy hole there.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Under the Cross\n%c[default]Buried a bit of loot under the cross, by the bush.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack Under the Tree\n%c[default]Dropped my backpack under a fallen tree.
%c[255,238,155,23]Chimney Sweep's Backpack\n%c[default]Shoved the backpack into a pipe near the factory. Nobody will find it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Rooftop Crate\n%c[default]Stashed a crate on the factory roof, nobody will see it there. It'll rust in the rain, though.
%c[255,238,155,23]Drunk's Backpack\n%c[default]They opened fire, had to ditch the backpack under a railcar, behind the wheel. But I got away. I'll come back for it later.
%c[255,238,155,23]By the Three Tanks\n%c[default]Hid it under a cross, behind the tanks. Dig a little, just don't get carried away.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack in the Porthole\n%c[default]Put a backpack up high in the factory, so it can't be seen from below. Can't remember what's in it, though.
%c[255,238,155,23]Radioactive Crate\n%c[default]Inside the factory, hid some stuff in a crate.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate in the Gap\n%c[default]Stash in a crate under the stairs.
%c[255,238,155,23]Factory Crate\n%c[default]Hid it in a little crate, nobody checks those anyway.
%c[255,238,155,23]Bag on the Pylon\n%c[default]Dropped a bag outside the window, I'll pick it up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Trash Crate\n%c[default]Me and Kolyan did well in Agroprom, hauled in all kinds of junk, but had to stash some of it. Put a crate in the trash container.
%c[255,238,155,23]Safe Under the Tree\n%c[default]Found a safe under a fallen tree, going to keep everything here for now.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stuff in the Pipe\n%c[default]Threw my stuff in the pipe, will pick it up later. Had to, or I'd have taken it with me, of course. Just hope it doesn't get wet.
%c[255,238,155,23]Radioactive Pipe\n%c[default]The goods are in an old pipe, should tell the boys. I'm not going in there.
%c[255,238,155,23]Rubble\n%c[default]Ran from the base, to hell with getting shot at by stalkers. Hid my gear in a pipe, in the rubble. I'll wait it out until they fly off, then come back for it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Safe Under the Bush\n%c[default]Half-buried safe under a bush, I hide everything here.
%c[255,238,155,23]Archive Box\n%c[default]Found a crate under a pylon, somebody dragged it all the way from the NII. We'll wait for the helicopter, then take it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Under the Hatch\n%c[default]Hid my stuff in an iron box.
%c[255,238,155,23]Bush by the Wall\n%c[default]Half-buried safe under a bush, I hide everything there.
%c[255,238,155,23]Institute Crate\n%c[default]Handy crate for dumping extra junk.
%c[255,238,155,23]Agro Safe\n%c[default]Hid it in a safe, then the military showed up. Can't get to the goods now.
%c[255,238,155,23]Truck Bed\n%c[default]Threw my gear in the pipe, will pick it up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Rotten Log\n%c[default]Pick up the stuff from the rotten log.
%c[255,238,155,23]Caretaker's Crate\n%c[default]Handy crate for dumping extra junk. It used to hold the Institute's maintenance supplies.
%c[255,238,155,23]Locksmith's Tools\n%c[default]Handy crate for small things, I used to keep my locksmith tools in one like it at home.
%c[255,238,155,23]Bandit Stash\n%c[default]Bandits are hiding something under the pipe, worth a visit. From what I overheard, it's their supplies.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack in the Nook\n%c[default]Hid my backpack behind chunks of concrete, going light. Better hungry than dead.

%c[255,238,155,23]Bloodsucker's Crate\n%c[default]Crate behind a rusty "barrel" in the underground, everything is there. I'm not going back, no way! I still don't remember how I managed to take down that bloodsucker.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stalker's Loot\n%c[default]The loot is behind the wall. I swear!
%c[255,238,155,23]Mole's Burrow\n%c[default]Dug up some valuables here. Tricky spot for my stash. On a yellow barrel, you'll never find it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Under the Cross\n%c[default]Under a cross, near the mountain, buried a bit of loot.
%c[255,238,155,23]Log Stash\n%c[default]Shoved my goods in a log, they won't find it, I think.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack Under the Bridge\n%c[default]Shoved the backpack under the bridge, let it lie for now.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Car\n%c[default]Put a crate in the car near the swamp.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stump Stash\n%c[default]Stash in a stump, good spot.
%c[255,238,155,23]Supply Crate\n%c[default]Found a great crate on the farm, will keep my supplies there for now.
%c[255,238,155,23]Pipe Stash\n%c[default]Threw my gear in the pipe, will pick it up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Under the Fir\n%c[default]Hid the backpack under a fir tree.

%c[255,238,155,23]Government Crate\n%c[default]The rookie finally swiped a crate from the bandits and put it in the overturned Niva. Says it looks like a government crate. Need to gear up some boys and get it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate\n%c[default]Thieves all around, they steal from their own now, but they won't find my little crate.
%c[255,238,155,23]Hatch Stash\n%c[default]Stashed my things in a hatch, they'll come in handy someday.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stalker's Backpack\n%c[default]Dropped the backpack under a tree, otherwise I wouldn't have gotten away from the bandits.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash\n%c[default]Put my junk in the pipe, will pick it up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Hidden Safe\n%c[default]Everything I swiped from Boar, I hid in the safe under the fir tree. Now to lie low while they're all on edge.
%c[255,238,155,23]Trailer Storage\n%c[default]Temporary HQ in a trailer, the supply crate is in there too.
%c[255,238,155,23]Hideout in the Pipe\n%c[default]Barely squeezed into the pipe under the road, now I've got a place to hide my backpack.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate of Goods\n%c[default]Tossed my goods in a crate, we'll pick them up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Behind the Pipe\n%c[default]Hiding my loot behind the pipe. Hard to reach, but it won't get swiped.
%c[255,238,155,23]Electrical Panel Stash\n%c[default]Stashed ammo in the electrical panel.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Crate\n%c[default]Everything we found, we left in a crate, we'll pick it up on the way back.
%c[255,238,155,23]Hidden Backpack\n%c[default]Stashed the rookie's backpack, he never found it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Forgotten Crate\n%c[default]A crate was left in the van, need to pick it up.
%c[255,238,155,23]Gas Station Safe\n%c[default]Found a safe at the gas station, hid my goods there, seems like few come around here.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate\n%c[default]Dragged a crate onto the tank.
%c[255,238,155,23]Gas Station Safe\n%c[default]Hid my supplies in the gas station safe.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate in the Car\n%c[default]In the bandit camp, there's some crate in a car. Need to sneak in unnoticed, I smell something worth grabbing.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate in the Stash\n%c[default]Put the crate in a stash, reliable spot.
%c[255,238,155,23]Abandoned Backpack\n%c[default]Left the backpack in an abandoned building, good thing nobody is around.

%c[255,238,155,23]Boar's Stash\n%c[default]We'll keep the goods in a safe, in an unnoticeable spot. Any day now the military will come and light a fire under everyone here, but they won't search for long, so the most valuable stuff stays with me.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack in a Hidden Spot\n%c[default]Stashed the backpack near the building.
%c[255,238,155,23]Unnoticeable Crate\n%c[default]Shoved the loot in an unnoticeable crate, will pick it up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Hidden Backpack\n%c[default]Hid the backpack under a car, nobody will poke around there.
%c[255,238,155,23]Car Stash\n%c[default]Hid the loot in a car right under the bandits' noses, no time to find anything better.
%c[255,238,155,23]Log Stash\n%c[default]Shoved my goods in a log, they won't find it, I think.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stove Stash\n%c[default]Hid my junk in the stove.
%c[255,238,155,23]KAMAZ Stash\n%c[default]Hid my junk in the cab of a KAMAZ.
%c[255,238,155,23]Treasure Under the Cross\n%c[default]Under a cross near the village, buried a bit of loot.
%c[255,238,155,23]Pipe Stash\n%c[default]Threw my gear in the pipe, will pick it up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Tower Treasure\n%c[default]Stash in the water tower, in a crate.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stove Stash\n%c[default]Shoved the backpack in the stove, it'll come in handy later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Car Stash\n%c[default]Hid the loot in a car, in the abandoned village.
%c[255,238,155,23]Dangerous Secret\n%c[default]Left a backpack in the ruins with radiation. They'll be afraid to go in.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stalker's Cache\n%c[default]Buried loot under a cross, in a hidden spot.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack With Gear\n%c[default]Hid a little backpack with gear in a hidden spot.
%c[255,238,155,23]Hilltop Stash\n%c[default]Hid my gear on the hill, in a car.

%c[255,238,155,23]Helicopter Crate\n%c[default]A helicopter went down near the abandoned military base, a crate lies close by, right under the helicopter. One problem, anomalies and radiation all around.
%c[255,238,155,23]Secret in the Grave\n%c[default]Buried loot on the hill under a cross.
%c[255,238,155,23]Secret Stump\n%c[default]Stash in a stump, good spot.
%c[255,238,155,23]Steeplejack's Stash\n%c[default]Left my backpack in the crane cab, will pick it up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Agreed Stash\n%c[default]Put everything in a crate, in a railcar not far from the base. Just as agreed, now all that's left is to wait.
%c[255,238,155,23]Treasure in the Log\n%c[default]Shoved my goods in a log, they won't find it, I think.
%c[255,238,155,23]Loot Pipe\n%c[default]Shoved the loot in a pipe on the lake shore.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stalker's Stash\n%c[default]Hid my stuff in an iron box.
%c[255,238,155,23]Loot in the Log\n%c[default]Shoved my goods in a log, they won't find it, I think.
%c[255,238,155,23]Handy Stash\n%c[default]Handy crate for dumping extra junk.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack in the Tunnel\n%c[default]Hid a backpack of loot in the tunnel.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate of Goods\n%c[default]Handy crate for dumping extra junk.
%c[255,238,155,23]Log Stash\n%c[default]Shoved my goods in a log, they won't find it, I think.
%c[255,238,155,23]Temporary Stash\n%c[default]Tossed my goods in a crate, will pick them up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Steel Stash\n%c[default]Stashed my things in a hatch, they'll come in handy someday.
%c[255,238,155,23]Loot Crate\n%c[default]Tossed my goods in a crate, will pick them up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Car Stash\n%c[default]Hid the loot in a car right under Freedom's nose, no time to find anything better.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Under the Cross\n%c[default]A cross on the hill, and a stash under it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Old Safe\n%c[default]They say there's a half-buried safe on a little island in the swamp. Worth a visit.
%c[255,238,155,23]Pipe With Goods\n%c[default]Shoved my goods in a pipe near the camp.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack Behind the Garages\n%c[default]Stashed the loot behind the garages.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack With Loot\n%c[default]Hid the backpack in a booth, right behind the iron thingy.
%c[255,238,155,23]Bus Stash\n%c[default]Put a little crate in the bus, looks unnoticeable.
%c[255,238,155,23]Loot in the Car\n%c[default]The loot is hidden in a car, not far from the territory. Radiation isn't too strong.
%c[255,238,155,23]Old Backpack\n%c[default]They say someone's loot is here, but you can't get through the radiation.
%c[255,238,155,23]Faction Stash\n%c[default]They say a faction's stash is here, how did they even get through the radiation?

%c[255,238,155,23]Tester's Backpack\n%c[default]Another volunteer stalker is gone, another prototype failed to protect against radiation. He made it only to the middle of the territory and stayed there. Sakharov wants more precise measurements, but I'm not going, or I'll stay there too, not far from the territory.
%c[255,238,155,23]Old Stash\n%c[default]They say someone's loot is here, but you can't get through the radiation.

%c[255,238,155,23]Scientist's Stash\n%c[default]Gotta bail. Sakharov and Kruglov are total nutcases, they want me to go with some stalker to the center of the radiation. To hell with them, as soon as I gather all my supplies in the hatch, I'm gone.
%c[255,238,155,23]Treasure in the Log\n%c[default]Shoved my goods in a log, they won't find it, I think.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate of Goods\n%c[default]They say someone's stash is here, but you can't get through the radiation.
%c[255,238,155,23]Gloomy's Treasure\n%c[default]A cross on the road to the Brain Scorcher, he went no further and hid everything under it.
%c[255,238,155,23]Dead Stalker's Loot\n%c[default]Some stalker died here, his loot is still lying around, nobody can pick it up.
%c[255,238,155,23]Loot in the Safe\n%c[default]They say there's a half-buried safe in the forest, packed with loot.

%c[255,238,155,23]Package for Duty\n%c[default]Told them not to fly over the Brain Scorcher, and look what happened. They came down in the middle of the forest, hardly anyone survived. What they sent us is lying somewhere there.

%c[255,238,155,23]Desperate Group's Supplies\n%c[default]They say a supply stash is left there by a group that fought its way to the center of the Zone, right under the Brain Scorcher's radiation. None of them came back, and the stash is still waiting for whoever picks it up.
%c[255,238,155,23]Faction Leader's Loot\n%c[default]They say the leader of some former faction died here, and he had rich loot on him.
%c[255,238,155,23]Dead Stalker's Gear\n%c[default]They say some famous stalker died here, and nobody has picked up his stuff yet.
%c[255,238,155,23]Garage Treasure\n%c[default]They say there's a crate in the garage, and it's packed with loot, holy cow.
%c[255,238,155,23]Old Stash\n%c[default]They say there's a crate in the kindergarten, and it's packed with loot, holy cow.
%c[255,238,155,23]Fang's Loot\n%c[default]Buried Fang in Pripyat, under the monument. Left all his loot there too, it's not right to take from the dead.

%c[255,238,155,23]Freedom Leader's Supplies\n%c[default]The last thing known about him is that he was the only one to survive the Emission. He left his supplies in some former department store and moved on. Everything went wrong, and he was the best Freedom leader in our whole history.

%c[255,238,155,23]Smokey's Stash\n%c[default]In the underground lab, Smokey put everything in a safe. Not a bad spot, nobody has keys to the lab. One problem, rocks suddenly fly through the air out of nowhere, they say somebody got crushed.
%c[255,238,155,23]Dropped Backpack\n%c[default]Had to drop the backpack.
%c[255,238,155,23]Hidden Backpack\n%c[default]Hid my backpack near the Duty base. Will pick it up later.
%c[255,238,155,23]Abandoned Backpack\n%c[default]A big pack of dogs chased me, if I hadn't dropped the backpack I wouldn't have made it to the outpost.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Under the Cross\n%c[default]Whatever was left, we buried under the cross.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack\n%c[default]Dropped my backpack here, easier this way.
%c[255,238,155,23]Bunker Storage\n%c[default]Duty outpost gear, kept in the bunker, but nobody watches the crate.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash\n%c[default]Saw a Duty guy stuff something in a pipe near the outpost.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash Under the Cross\n%c[default]It all belonged to him, let it lie here for now.
%c[255,238,155,23]Backpack\n%c[default]Heading to the Bar, left my backpack in the hangar.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash in the Electrical Panel\n%c[default]They say there's something valuable in an electrical panel on Duty territory.
%c[255,238,155,23]Tower Stash\n%c[default]Wedged a little box at the top of the tower near Duty where nobody will notice.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash\n%c[default]Hid it in a pipe under the stairs.

%c[255,238,155,23]Arni's Stash\n%c[default]Stashed the goods not far from the Bar, behind the anomalies, nobody can get near. And they don't know how to open it either, it's simple, you just pry the door and it opens.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash\n%c[default]Stashed the goods not far from the Bar.
%c[255,238,155,23]Crate\n%c[default]In a crate near the Bar.
%c[255,238,155,23]Little Box\n%c[default]Stashed a little box in a back alley near the Bar.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash\n%c[default]Buried under the cross, behind the fir trees.
%c[255,238,155,23]Stash\n%c[default]Under a cross, not far from the passage to the Wild Territory.
